title: AnalysisRequest
description: Names the repository an analysis.get or analysis.run call applies to, and what a run should ask the model for. The path travels on every call rather than being held as host state, for the same reason it does on profile requests: the renderer owns which repository is open, and a stale host-side selection would be a way to spend money analysing the wrong one.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root, as repository.open returned it.

changeClusters.description: Whether this run should also produce the change-clusters grouping. Absent means the choice the host remembers, so a renderer that does not know about this field cannot change what a run costs. Ignored by analysis.get, which spends nothing.

implementationGroups.description: Whether this run should also declare which abstractions were changed alongside their implementations, so the diagram can draw each as one box. Absent means the choice the host remembers, as for changeClusters. Ignored by analysis.get.
